name: Robust_LDM_Benchmark
description: A benchmark that evaluates the robustness of Latent Diffusion Models (LDMs) to input perturbations, corruptions, and distribution shifts. It provides curated corrupted inputs and reference outputs to measure generation fidelity, perceptual similarity, and semantic consistency under adverse conditions. The benchmark is intended for assessing model degradation and robustness-improvement strategies for image generative models.
reputation: A small, specialized benchmark used by researchers studying diffusion-model robustness; limited broad adoption.
